newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-RAYTHEON SELLS $3.0 BLN IN DEBT.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-RAYTHEON SELLS $3.0 BLN IN DEBT.

text.p: The following four-tranche debt deal from Raytheon Co was priced on Thursday, according to joint-lead manager Morgan Stanley, Dean Witter & Discover Co.
The offering was increased to $3.0 billion from an original size of $2.5 billion.
Raytheon is a major U.S. manufacturer of missiles and defense electronics.
Other joint-lead underwriters were Bear Stearns & Co Inc, and Credit Suisse First Boston.
